data.title: Matthew Li gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
Hi Matthew,

Thank you for reaching out to us! I am happy to clarify our shipping prices. Standard shipping & handling is 10% of each item’s pre-discounted listed retail price. If an item is considered oversize or fragile there will be an additional freight fee required by the freight carrier of $149- $369. Orders that contain mixed shipping methods and/or preorder items may have more than one shipping fee applied at checkout.

White-Glove delivery is an additional freight fee added to the standard shipping & handling to ensure fragile/oversized items are delivered safely to the final destination. White-Glove Delivery includes additional care while the item is in transit, unloading, assembly, placement, inspections, and trash removal of the item.

Unfortunately, we are unable to waive or discount these fees as these are the current discounted rates we have with our suppliers and freight carriers. Please know we are continuing to work with our supplier and freight carriers to lower freight fees when possible. I apologize for any inconvenience. Please Let me know if I can help with anything else in the meantime!
